decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 3 - It is considered that this application for the erection of a privacy screen (1.9 metres high and 2.5 metres wide)  subject to conditions would not be detrimental to the appearance of the residential flat building, the amenity of the adjoining dwellings, or the character of the street scene. The development is in accordance with Policy ENV - B.1.1 (New Development), and Appendix 1 (Privacy and Spacing between Buildings) of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003 and is compliant with Unitary Development Plan - Supplementary Planning Guidelines.
description: Erection of a 1.9m. high privacy screen to existing flat.
